format_note: Compatible with the skill-creator eval format (prompt + expected_output + files). Run manually per README.md, or wire into skill-creator's eval harness later.

evals.prompt: Migrate this application from the Perplexity Sonar API to the Agent API.
evals.expected_output: All three scripts call POST https://api.perplexity.ai/v1/agent. Filters move inside tools:[{type:web_search,filters:{...}}]; max_tokens becomes max_output_tokens; sources are read from the search_results output item (no top-level citations); the related-questions feature is preserved via a documented workaround, not silently dropped; the streaming consumer handles response.output_text.delta plus all terminal events; non-streaming code branches on response.status. All three scripts run successfully against production, and check.sh passes on the migrated directory.

evals.prompt: Migrate this application from the Perplexity Sonar API to the Agent API.
evals.expected_output: Same rubric as case 1, but in the Perplexity SDK style: client.chat.completions.create(...) becomes client.responses.create(...) on the same client, filter kwargs move into the web_search tool, max_tokens becomes max_output_tokens, output is read via response.output_text or the output[] walk, sources come from the search_results output item, streaming iterates typed events instead of delta.content. check.sh passes on the migrated directory.

evals.prompt: My Perplexity code returns 400 with error message: invalid request body: json: unknown field "max_tokens" - after I pointed it at /v1/agent. Fix it.
evals.expected_output: The skill auto-triggers on the error string. It renames max_tokens to max_output_tokens AND checks the rest of the request for other leftover Sonar-only fields (the strict-mode remove list: top-level search filters, return_related_questions), and fixes the stale choices/citations response parsing instead of stopping at the one named field.

evals.prompt: After migrating to the Agent API my app lost its citations - result["citations"] is always missing. Fix it.
evals.expected_output: The skill auto-triggers on the missing-citations symptom. It rewrites source handling to read the search_results output item from output[] (results[].url/title/snippet) and notes that message annotations are often empty and must not be relied on.
